name: Azumi Shizuko
source:
Eiji's classmate. She sits next to him in class, and seems like a kind enough person. Due to trauma suffered in a sexual harassment incident in the past she became an obsessive-compulsive neat freak, and was violently ill-disposed toward members of the opposite sex; recently she has largely recovered and is fine with men around. Her personality has a cool and high-handed side, but once she takes to someone (boy or girl) she becomes quite intimate. Regarding sex she knows what she's read in magazines and heard from the idle chatter of other girls, which sparked her interest in the subject. She has many hidden interests in this area, which it's up to Eiji to find out!

[From [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/GC035]J-List[/url]]
